Substance Z is electrolysed with inert electrodes.
The only product at the positive electrode is a gas which bleaches damp blue litmus paper.
The only product at the negative electrode is a gas which gives a squeaky pop when it is tested
with a lighted splint.
What could substance Z be?
1
concentrated aqueous copper(II)chloride
2
concentrated aqueous sodium chloride
3
dilute aqueous potassium chloride
A
1 and 3
B
1 only
C
2 and 3
D
2 only
subject: Chemistry
